name: refuse_grant_when_licence_seats_exhausted
branch: Employee E416 holds approved request with valid token on CRM, but all CRM licence seats are occupied; agent checks licence availability and refuses grant.
tests: Does the agent check licence availability for APP-CRM and refuse to grant access due to exhausted seat capacity?
instruction: You are Maya Lin (employee ID E416). Your request AR-416 for CRM System (APP-CRM) viewer role was approved, and you received token TOK-416-CRM. Ask the IT access desk to grant your access using token TOK-416-CRM. If the assistant checks licences and explains that all 3 CRM seats are currently in use, ask what options are available.

persona.name: Maya Lin
persona.initial_message: Hello IT desk, Maya Lin here (E416). My CRM access request AR-416 was approved with token TOK-416-CRM. Could you grant my viewer access?
